brief: Why every brand needs a design system in 2026 — and how to build one.

slots.headline: Why every brand needs a design system in 2026
slots.swipeNote: Swipe through six steps to build yours now

slots.title: Audit your existing brand assets first
slots.body: Start by inventorying every logo, color, font, and component across your channels. Most brands already own 60 percent of what they need. Map the gaps before you build.

slots.title: Define tokens for colors and type
slots.body: Tokens are the single source of truth for spacing, color, and typography. They turn subjective choices into scalable code. Lock them early to prevent drift.

slots.title: Build reusable components in Figma
slots.body: Components save hours of rework and keep every screen consistent. Design atoms, molecules, and organisms that flex across breakpoints. Reuse, don’t recreate.

slots.title: Write docs that your team will use
slots.body: A system without guidance is just a dusty folder. Record usage rules, accessibility standards, and do’s and don’ts. Good docs turn users into champions.

slots.title: Train teams to adopt the system
slots.body: Launch workshops that show designers and developers how to contribute. Adoption lives or dies by internal advocacy. Make the system easier than starting from scratch.

slots.title: Iterate based on real product needs
slots.body: Treat your system as a living product, not a one-time project. Schedule quarterly reviews and gather feedback. Evolution beats perfection every time.

slots.quote: Consistency is the fastest way to scale
slots.headline: Start building your design system today
